verdict.rationale: Probes confirm that bitwarden.com serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200). They also show that help pages ship per-page markdown mirrors (e.g., /help/cli.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how well agents actually consume these docs, and any first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or markdown-mirror offering.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://bitwarden.com/llms.txt # Bitwarden
help pages ship real per-page .md mirrors — https://bitwarden.com/help/cli.md returns markdown starting '# Password Manager CLI'.
